hypotheses.P1_adjacent_name_is_specific: L8H1 has matched effect AUROC at least 0.60 for adjacent proper-name pieces and exceeds the other ranked heads' median by at least 0.05 in both splits.
hypotheses.P2_boundary_read_is_specific: L9H8 has matched effect AUROC at least 0.60 for newline/period sources and exceeds the other ranked heads' median by at least 0.05 in both splits.
hypotheses.P3_function_word_read_is_specific: L9H7 has matched effect AUROC at least 0.60 for adjacent function-word reads and exceeds the other ranked heads' median by at least 0.05 in both splits.
hypotheses.P4_long_range_capitalized_is_specific: L8H2 has matched effect AUROC at least 0.60 for long-range capitalized sources and exceeds the other ranked heads' median by at least 0.05 in both splits.
hypotheses.P5_some_new_relation_is_validated: At least two preregistered expected head/relation pairs pass their specific tests.
hypotheses.P6_unsupervised_relation_candidates_exis: At least one repetition/induction-style relation has matched AUROC at least 0.65 in both splits for the same head.
